---
title: "About"
readiness: partially_implementable
---

This site documents the assumptions behind a component-level techno-economic model for offshore wind infrastructure.

The model compares electricity-based export, centralised offshore hydrogen production, and decentralised turbine-integrated hydrogen production. The documentation here is limited to methodology and assumptions: system boundaries, component cost models, energy balances, availability factors, installation assumptions, and shared financial conventions.

The model is under development. Hover over a sidebar link to see whether each
page is context only, not reviewed, blocked, partially implementable,
implementable with declared uncertainty, or ready. A section tooltip reports the
least-ready calculation page in that section; it is not an editorial-completion
percentage.

| Readiness | Interpretation |
|---|---|
| **Not reviewed** | The page has not completed the structured model review. |
| **Context** | No standalone model calculation is expected. |
| **Blocked** | Material missing inputs or decisions prevent implementation. |
| **Partial** | Part of the calculation is implementable, but material gaps remain. |
| **Ready — uncertain** | Implementable with material uncertainty explicitly declared. |
| **Ready** | Implementable from the documented inputs and assumptions. |

The source base includes the formal public bibliography and controlled working
documents. Public evidence can be checked independently. Internal supplier,
manufacturer and project evidence can be reproduced only by authorised readers
with access to the controlled source. Where a public fallback, bounded range or
sufficient derivation is absent, confidential evidence is not independently
reproducible and the affected result remains limited or blocked.

See [References and Evidence Status](references.qmd) for the access and model-use
classification of every catalog record.
